rules.sample: uniform users after excluding every v1 sampled UID; full available histories
rules.cohort: uniform development subset before reading outcomes; remaining users confirmation
rules.training: early training queries from both cohorts; not a cold-user experiment
rules.validation: tune/select queries from development users only
rules.confirmation: test queries from confirmation users only, query.day<end_day; their tune/select rows are not supervised fitting/evaluation targets, while causal earlier events remain available history
rules.label: first timestamp/source-order listen per user-item-day across sources, then is_organic==0; ratio>=50
rules.sealing: test label absent from queries and test target ratio/duration absent from all queries; separate test_labels.parquet
rules.sealing_limit: procedural guard only: complete raw histories retain later outcomes for declared rolling evaluation
